bias.zh: 反弹 · 站上 10 日均线，仍低于 $173–175

read.en: Palantir fell 0.5% on Nov 12 to $171.58, trading $168.25–173.05 on light volume (0.47x the 20-day average). It is above the 5-day ($168.5), 10-day ($170.7), rising 100-day ($166.1) and 200-day ($153.6) and below the 30-day ($188.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($153.06), and RSI is 41.9.
read.zh: Palantir 11月12日下跌 0.5%，收于 $171.58，盘中区间 $168.25–173.05，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.47 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$168.5）、10 日（$170.7）以及上行的 100 日（$166.1）和 200 日均线（$153.6）上方，30 日均线（$188.6）下方。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$153.06），RSI 为 41.9。

read.en: The close held the $170–171 band and settled above the falling 10-day, now support; the $173.05 high stayed under the Nov 11 high. Resistance is $173.1–175.4, then $176.5–178.3 and $184.5 (Oct 16 low). Support is $168.3–170.8 (5 and 10-day, Nov 11–12 lows), then $164–166.1 (100-day) and $153–153.6 (SAR, 200-day). A close above $175.4 would target $177–178; below $168.3, $164–166.
